title: Reading Drill — Notes from a Small Weather Station
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Notes from a Small Weather Station
passages.body:
**A** A school mounted two temperature sensors in its grounds. To find out whether exposure mattered, one sensor was installed beside a wall and the other in an open wooden screen.

**B** The wall sensor reported the highest temperature just after lunch. On cloudy afternoons the results were closer, suggesting that the wall affected readings mainly when there was direct sunlight.

**C** Rather than delete the unexpectedly high readings, the students marked them as a separate series. They compared both plots when discussing the importance of sensor placement.
